notes.title: 🧫 TRY SLiMECORE THURSDAYS!!! 🧫
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049770/1731ada09ac5576e65a7e0e2b65d8f92d51690d4.png[/img]

[h2]🧫 WHO UP SLiMIN' THEY CORE???[/h2]
[list]
[*] Thursdays Starting at 6:30pm PST // 9:30pm EST
[*] Servers will be up for 2 hours minimum, but will likely be extended
[*] An hour early we'll open up training and AI bot matches so you aren't coming in cold
[*] More stuff will be posted in our Discord as the playtest is happening. Don't be shy come say hi
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049770/3a2b08e44e538f96f177754ffcbd516b88c26eca.png[/img]
[h2]🧫Join the playtest[/h2]
It's pretty easy to get in.
Just make sure that you've opted into playtests by clicking the 'Request Access' button here on our Steam page.

[h2]🧫ABOUT [url=https://genpopinteractive.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049770/d84f43801d5d1646d4ae0e0ab138e9ee1087d0c5.png[/img][/url][/h2]
We're a small indie studio trying to make the type of shooter that a behemoth AAA companies can't (big stupid changes to make the game as insane as possible). If you want to support this kind of thing please invite your friends and tell them the game was your idea if it help. For real though we do rely very much on your input.

We're extremely excited to show you what we've been working on!
[url=https://discord.gg/slimecore][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049770/14e16ee4f9382c22a41cc2a64c285193f1ee19fd.png[/img]
[/url]
